headline: CPN Against Inflation. Minister Motyka: Package Reduces Growth by 1 Percentage Point
summary: Energy Minister Miłosz Motyka told the Sejm the CPN package reduces inflation by 1 percentage point per month. He said it also reduces growth by 1 percentage point.
why: Government anti-inflation packages change consumer prices and economic growth, which influences Polish rates, the złoty and domestic company earnings.
